lede.zh: 这份报告在 8×A100、4 个 Qwen3-32B TP2 副本上测试共享 KV 缓存池。对长上下文多轮流量，280 GB DRAM 池覆盖工作集并制造真实跨实例复用；C10 的 TTFT P50 降低 3.37×，SLO goodput 提高 2.44×。
lede.en: This report evaluates a shared KV cache pool across four Qwen3-32B TP2 replicas on 8× A100. For long-context multi-turn traffic, a 280 GB DRAM pool covers the working set and enables real cross-replica reuse; at C10, median TTFT improves 3.37× and SLO goodput rises 2.44×.

snapshot.zh: 共享 KV 池开关对照 · 真实长上下文多轮 Agent
snapshot.en: Shared KV pool on/off · long-context multi-turn Agent traffic

heading.zh: 收益取决于工作集与路由
heading.en: Benefits depend on working set and routing

intro.zh: 池关闭时本地缓存命中约 30%；启用后本地命中约 31%，共享池再补约 33%。C10 的时延与 goodput 改善来自跨实例命中；C30 时 decode TPOT 已超 SLO，prefill 缓存只能部分改善表现。
intro.en: With the pool off, local cache hits are about 30%. With it on, local hits are about 31%, and the shared pool adds about 33%. C10 latency and goodput gains come from cross-replica hits; at C30, decode TPOT exceeds the SLO, so prefill caching only partially improves behavior.

note.zh: 这是条件型优化：工作集需大于单副本 GPU 缓存，池容量需覆盖工作集，同时路由要产生跨副本 miss。短上下文或工作集能留在本地缓存时，外部池可能没有收益。
note.en: This is conditional: the working set must exceed local GPU cache, the pool must cover it, and routing must create cross-replica misses. Short contexts or a working set that stays local may see no benefit.

heading.zh: 工作集超过单副本缓存时，共享池提升首字延迟与达标吞吐
heading.en: When the working set exceeds local cache, a shared pool improves TTFT and SLO goodput

intro.zh: 采用 120 个长上下文会话、每会话约 18K token，round-robin 路由制造跨实例缓存缺失。开启 280 GB DRAM 池后，记录 TTFT、TPOT、达标吞吐和总请求吞吐。
intro.en: The workload uses 120 long-context sessions of about 18K tokens each, with round-robin routing to create cross-replica cache misses. TTFT, TPOT, SLO goodput, and total request throughput are measured with a 280 GB DRAM pool enabled and disabled.

hint.zh: Goodput 定义：TTFT ≤2 s 且 TPOT ≤100 ms 的请求吞吐。
hint.en: Goodput counts requests meeting TTFT ≤2 s and TPOT ≤100 ms.

notes.zh: C10 时共享池将 TTFT P50 从 3.96 s 降至 1.17 s，goodput 从 0.36 提至 0.88 req/s；C30 goodput 从 0.18 提至 0.37 req/s。C30 TPOT P90 仍为 415.9 ms，decode 已超过 100 ms SLO，池缓存无法单独修复该瓶颈。
notes.en: At C10, the pool lowers median TTFT from 3.96 s to 1.17 s and raises goodput from 0.36 to 0.88 req/s; at C30, goodput rises from 0.18 to 0.37 req/s. At C30, TPOT P90 remains 415.9 ms, above the 100 ms SLO, so shared caching alone cannot resolve the decode bottleneck.

heading.zh: 280 GB 池覆盖工作集后，跨实例命中补上约三分之一前缀
heading.en: A 280 GB pool covering the working set adds cross-replica hits for about one third of prefixes

intro.zh: 测量本地 prefix cache 与外部共享池的有效命中贡献，并用隔离单请求验证跨实例取回时延。
intro.en: Local prefix-cache hits and external shared-pool hits are measured separately; an isolated request validates cross-replica retrieval latency.

title.zh: 前缀由本地缓存 / 共享池服务
title.en: Prefix served by local cache / shared pool

hint.zh: 约 65% 总命中由本地 31% + 共享池新增 33% 构成。
hint.en: About 65% total hits comprise 31% local plus 33% from the shared pool.

notes.zh: 另一次隔离取回测量为跨实例读取 295 ms，对照冷重算 1,050 ms。该值是单请求隔离对照，不代表每个请求的端到端 TTFT。
notes.en: An isolated retrieval measured 295 ms for cross-replica fetch versus 1,050 ms for cold recomputation. This is an isolated single-request comparison, not end-to-end TTFT for every request.

methodIntro.zh: 使用官方 vLLM 多轮基准工具，先预热再采集逐请求统计；round-robin 刻意形成跨实例缓存缺失。比较共享池关闭 / 开启两个并发档，按请求是否满足 TTFT 与 TPOT 双阈值计算 SLO goodput。
methodIntro.en: The official vLLM multi-turn benchmark was warmed up before per-request measurements. Round-robin routing intentionally creates cross-replica cache misses. Pool-off/on results were measured at two concurrency levels, with SLO goodput counting requests that satisfy both TTFT and TPOT thresholds

methodNotes.zh: 主结果来自 C10/C30 两档闭环流量；其他池大小和更深会话轮次是边界/佐证实验，不与主矩阵合并。共享池容量不足以容纳工作集时会发生池内驱逐。
methodNotes.en: Primary results are from closed-loop C10/C30 traffic. Other pool sizes and deeper-turn sessions are corroborating or boundary tests and are not pooled with the main matrix. A pool too small for the working set will evict entries.
